books.coreIdea: You are stronger than your changing feelings.
Do the right thing and do your best.
Wisdom helps us make better choices.
You can do good things without always thinking about yourself.
Your mind can become your friend.
The world is more connected than it looks.
Goodness and love can be found everywhere.
Look closely at the wonders around you.
You are part of something much bigger.
Notice what is happening inside you.
Different moods can pull us in different directions.
Every day, we can choose what kind of person we want to become.
Our habits shape who we become.
Understand yourself, make wise choices, and do what is right.

adventures.coreIdea: Sometimes I feel confused.
adventures.title: Too Much at Once
adventures.pairingRationale: Vanshi feels deeply; Aarav helps her slow down and understand
adventures.storyFeeling: When everything feels like too much
adventures.synopsis: Vanshi and Aarav: When everything feels like too much. Vanshi feels deeply; Aarav helps her slow down and understand.
adventures.moral: When everything feels like too much, you can name it — and choose one small thing first.
adventures.childRepeatLine: I can name when it's too much.
adventures.rememberLine: In the Bhagavad Gita, from India's great puranas, a warrior stands where he must act — but first his body speaks. His skin burns. His mind reels. He cannot see a good path ahead, and he will not pretend otherwise. Naming that honest overwhelm is not the end of courage. Sometimes it is where clear thinking can begin.
adventures.openingHook: Grove Club planned a small celebration under the Old Banyan — decorations, games, and a shared snack table.
adventures.page25Teaser: Tomorrow at the library, Aarav has four ideas for the Grove Journal wall — and every idea looks wrong once he imagines failing. Kabir is already at the window, wondering what would happen if they just started in one corner.
adventures.page25WonderQuestion: Can you begin when you do not know the whole map?
